description: Bootstrap collapse plugin version 2.0.4, providing toggle, show, hide, and transition functionalities for collapsible elements in web UI.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Class managing the collapse behavior of UI elements, including show, hide, toggle, and transition handling.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.dimension
methods.description: Determines whether the element collapses in width or height.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.show
methods.description: Expands the collapsible element with transition effects.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.hide
methods.description: Collapses the element with transition effects.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.reset
methods.description: Resets the element's size to a specified value.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.transition
methods.description: Handles the transition process for showing or hiding the element.

methods.name: Collapse.prototype.toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
